description: A flaw has been found in GPAC up to f1219cde. Affected by this vulnerability is the function gf_node_get_field_count of the file scenegraph/base_scenegraph.c of the component MP4Box. Executing a manipulation can lead to reachable assertion. It is possible to launch the attack on the local host. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version abi-16.23 addresses this issue. This patch is called 49dee5cad329cfed310c1682703df7daa47df31a. You should upgrade the affected component.
